text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- The Portuguese government has received pledges to repay 179 billion escudos of tax and social security arrears under the so-called "Mateus Plan."
- Ruling Socialist Party divided over changes to the abortion law.
- An opinion poll shows support for the ruling Socialist Party slipping because of the rising cost of living. The Socialists retain a lead over the centre-right opposition Social Democrats.
- Somague to lead a consortium bidding to build a train link over the April 25 bridge that crosses the River Tagus near Lisbon.
